description: This file defines the ClasspathLocationResolver class, which implements the LocationResolver interface to resolve locations using classpath resources with additional options.

classes.name: ClasspathLocationResolver
classes.description: A resolver that uses string URLs with enhanced options for locating resources on the classpath.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Overrides the method to resolve a location string to a URL; delegates to the overloaded method.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string to a URL, optionally using a class loader.
